notes: Preliminary whole-timeline frame sampling and actual ffprobe/FFmpeg sound analysis. NOT a completed full human signoff. Do not set REVIEWED without full individual visual/audio/child-safety check and concrete tested fixes. Screenshot in question shows another channel but no second different video is attached.

observations.finding: The movie properly starts with an in-world HELLO scene rather than repeating the promotional cover.
observations.change: Keep cover-only scene 01 and in-world greeting scene 02 as a proven retained improvement.

observations.finding: Once narration ends at second 14, the music falls to roughly minus forty-four dBFS average, making the rest of the workout extremely quiet.
observations.change: Change the music ducking and gain for the exercise section and listen on both phone speakers and headphones, verify against actual rendered MP4.

observations.finding: SPYGLASS TURN says to turn shoulders but the boy also raises a hand to his eye, making shoulder movement less clear.
observations.change: Reject images when the pose mainly acts out a story prop instead of demonstrating the exact safe physical instruction.

observations.finding: LOOKOUT TIPTOES barely shows heel elevation, so viewers may not know which body movement to perform.
observations.change: Require a visually identifiable controlled tiny heel gap while preserving a safe steady pose and floor contact options.

observations.finding: CRAB SIDE STEP looks more like a shallow wide squat than a distinct sideways step, despite the on-screen instruction.
observations.change: Make a QA pose comparison between scene image and exact script instruction mandatory; regenerate only before approval when really necessary and authorized.

observations.finding: The child remains still through each twenty-second exercise and sees no actual demonstration of getting into the target hold.
observations.change: Design and test a safe short pose-entry motion proof of concept in a future revision rather than pretending the current still-image engine can animate.

nextActions.action: Set exercise-background-music gain after the introductory voice to an audible tested mix; check true segment loudness and the actual MP4 end fade.
Check that every photographed pose makes the exact safe exercise action immediately obvious, especially shoulder-turn, tiptoe, and side-step movements.
Keep consistent warm playground storyworld and the HELLO-first video opening, while introducing a more meaningful treasure-quest sense of progress.
Prototype short safety-tested pose-entry animation clips before each twenty-second hold; requires a separately validated engine change.

requiredBeforeFinalApproval: Watch entire actual MP4 with sound, verify child movements, completion of whole scene sequence and accurate captions, then sign off. Do not claim REVIEWED from frame samples and loudness alone.
